  1. **Basic Tune-Up**: $40, includes adjustment of brakes, derailleurs, quick wheel true, lubrication, and safety inspection.
  2. **Deluxe Tune-Up**: $75, includes everything in Basic, plus cleaning, installation of new cables, and adjustments to headset and bottom bracket.
  3. **Pro Tune-Up**: $120, includes everything in Deluxe, plus advanced wheel truing, custom adjustments, and application of advanced lubricants.
